name: parakeet-openai-like-server
description: OpenAI/whisper-compatible HTTP API in front of the parakeet_web ONNX pipeline.
//engines: Node 20 is the floor for the globals this server relies on with no polyfill: File, and Request.formData() for multipart parsing (which is why there is no multipart dependency). The image and CI both run 22.
//: The default (PARAKEET_ORT=wasm) path has NO npm dependency at all: it uses the vendored app/ui/vendor/onnxruntime-web Node build. onnxruntime-node is needed ONLY for PARAKEET_ORT=node|cuda and is pinned to the same ORT generation as that vendored build (1.27.0) so both backends run the same engine version.
